response.sql:
WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
), differences AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference
  FROM shares
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_difference
FROM differences
ORDER BY share_difference DESC
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES;

assumptions.assumption: Only observatories represented by at least one telescope are included; the average share is across those observatories.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every observatory in the observatories table, including those with zero telescopes, in the average share and results.
alternatives.sql:
WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
), differences AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference
  FROM shares
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_difference
FROM differences
ORDER BY share_difference DESC
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES;
